_comment: Phase 6.3 offline decomposer A/B battery. Run validation/evals/decomposition.py. No sim; one LLM call per prompt per arm.

prompts.prompt: Get the orange Pringles and bring them to the checkout counter.
prompts.looking_for: pickup(orange Pringles) -> checkout. Exactly ONE checkout leg, not goto+place.

prompts.prompt: Grab a Coke and take it to the counter to pay.
prompts.looking_for: pickup(Coke) -> checkout. 'pay' must map to the checkout type.

prompts.prompt: Bring the green Piattos and a Coke to the counter, one at a time.
prompts.looking_for: pickup -> checkout -> pickup -> checkout (interleaved, one item at a time), two checkout legs.

prompts.prompt: I want the Jin Ramen and the Leslie's Clover Chips checked out.
prompts.looking_for: two pickup+checkout pairs even though 'pick up' is never said; 'checked out' -> checkout.

prompts.prompt: Of the two Pik Nik sizes on the shelf, bring the larger one to the counter.
prompts.looking_for: a compare leg (targets=[the two Pik Niks], criterion=size) that routes to BOTH before choosing, then pickup+checkout of the winner. Decision from looking, not the product index.

prompts.prompt: Between the two Pringles cans, buy the cheaper one.
prompts.looking_for: compare(criterion=price) from the shelf/tag, then pickup+checkout. 'buy' -> checkout, not a new type.

prompts.prompt: Buy snacks for 100 pesos or less - bring them to the counter.
prompts.looking_for: pickup+checkout legs; the budget is carried in the text, not a new type. Should NOT invent shelf numbers.

prompts.prompt: Pick out some chips under a 50 peso budget and check them out.
prompts.looking_for: pickup+checkout; 'check them out' -> checkout; budget stays in text.

prompts.prompt: Obtain the green Piattos and deposit them at the till.
prompts.looking_for: pickup(green Piattos) -> checkout. NONE of obtain/deposit/till are keyword-guarded; typing is what makes this halt-checkable at all.

prompts.prompt: Fetch a bottle of water and leave it at the self-checkout.
prompts.looking_for: pickup(bottle of water) -> checkout. 'fetch' is not a pickup keyword; 'self-checkout' is the counter.
a SINGLE-element array: one pickup(milk). No spurious checkout.

prompts.prompt: Count the Piattos on this shelf.
prompts.looking_for: a SINGLE inspect(query=count Piattos) leg with no manipulation.

prompts.prompt: Read and report the expiration date printed on the milk.
prompts.looking_for: goto(milk) THEN inspect(query=expiration date), no manipulation. The query names a specific product and no earlier leg goes there, so the leading goto is REQUIRED (was ['inspect'] before 2026-07-30 - an inspect leg cannot travel, so a bare inspect reads from wherever the agent spawned).

prompts.prompt: Read the expiration dates and pick up the one that is not expired.
prompts.looking_for: inspect(query=which is not expired) followed by a separate pickup leg.

prompts.prompt: Compare the nutritional facts of the two cereals and tell me which has less sugar.
prompts.looking_for: MUST type as inspect, NOT compare - the decision reads printed nutrition labels, not overall appearance. pickup(s) of the two cereals then a single inspect(query=which has less sugar) leg.

prompts.prompt: Find the Choco Mallows and tell me the price.
prompts.looking_for: goto(Choco Mallows) THEN inspect(query=price). The 2026-07-30 regression case: a bare inspect pair ran from spawn and never found the product at all.

prompts.prompt: Count the Vcut chips on this shelf.
prompts.looking_for: a SINGLE inspect leg - 'on this shelf' says the agent is already there, so the goto rule must NOT fire. The over-firing control for inspect-goto-price.
